_doc: Negative-proof ledger. A control is trusted only after an attributed failure on deliberate broken input and a verified restored pass. agent-settings#1130: local executable gates proved on 2026-09-19; CI workflow candidates classified but not fabricated into this ledger until each has its own fail-for-right-reason + restored-pass proof.

gates.description: Desktop postbuild guard: refuse to package when apps/desktop/dist lacks index.html plus a JS assets bundle (blank-page packaging failure).

observedFailure.breakApplied: Clean checkout with apps/desktop/dist absent. The proof harness also calls checkDistBuilt() against a missing temp dist directory.
observedFailure.reason: CLI printed 'assert-dist-built: no dist directory at .../apps/desktop/dist' and exited 1. Harness matched /no dist directory/ on the function result.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Created a minimal apps/desktop/dist with non-empty index.html and assets/*.js; CLI printed 'assert-dist-built: dist/index.html + assets present' and exited 0. Harness restored-pass path also exited 0. Proof dist and temp dirs were deleted afterward.
observedFailure.proofScope: Local packaging guard only. Does not prove electron-builder, vite, or hosted desktop CI.

gates.description: Desktop dev/build guard: require repo-root node_modules/vite before renderer tooling runs.

observedFailure.breakApplied: Clean checkout without node_modules/vite/package.json (natural broken input).
observedFailure.reason: CLI printed 'Run from repo root: ... && npm ci' and exited 1.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Wrote a temporary node_modules/vite/package.json stub; CLI exited 0 with no error. Stub and node_modules were removed afterward. Proof harness exits 0 only when both sides of the ritual succeed.
observedFailure.proofScope: Presence check for root vite install only. Does not prove npm ci, lockfile integrity, or a full desktop build.

gates.description: Fork-local component sourcing preflight: every web/src/components/*.(tsx|jsx) file must be baselined or covered by a sourcing record.

observedFailure.breakApplied: Planted web/src/components/_gate_evidence_uncovered.tsx with no baseline entry and no docs/preflight record.
observedFailure.reason: Printed COMPONENT_SOURCING_PREFLIGHT=fail and named the planted file as a new component with no sourcing-preflight record; exit 1.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Deleted the planted file; same command printed COMPONENT_SOURCING_PREFLIGHT=pass (26 components: 26 baselined, 0 record-covered; 0 records) and exited 0.
observedFailure.proofScope: Fork-local preflight over web/src/components only. Does not prove React runtime behavior or hosted UI CI.

gates.description: Grep-based Windows footgun checker used by lint workflow --all and by explicit path scans before PRs.

observedFailure.breakApplied: Committed deliberate fixture tests/gate-evidence/windows-footgun/deliberate_os_kill.py containing a bare os.kill(pid, 0) without a suppression marker. tests/ is outside the checker's --all roots, so the fixture does not poison the lint workflow full scan.
observedFailure.reason: Reported '[os.kill(pid, 0)]' on the fixture line with the CTRL_C_EVENT Windows attribution and exited 1 with '1 Windows footgun(s) found'.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Scanning tests/gate-evidence/windows-footgun/restored_os_kill.py (same call with '# windows-footgun: ok') printed 'No Windows footguns found' and exited 0. Proof harness requires both sides.
observedFailure.proofScope: One rule (os.kill pid 0) via explicit path scan. Does not re-prove every FOOTGUNS pattern or the lint.yml workflow_call wiring.
